Written in plain language with real steps and real costs, this volume skips the theory and gets to the fix. Circuit breakers — what trips them, how to reset them correctly, and how to label your panel before you need it at midnight. GFCI outlets — why outlets lose power for no apparent reason, how to find and reset the right GFCI, and how to map which outlets are on each circuit. Replacing a light switch or outlet — with mandatory voltage-tester safety steps, wire-by-wire instructions, and clear guidance on when to stop and call an electrician.
